messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p-prod-serving-42 (gpu-13) reported CUDA OOMs while headroom metric shows ~2.1GB available. 5 OOM events in 60s. Auto-mitigation attempted: none (policy=monitor).

amelia: ack, I’m oncall. pulling logs and metrics now. tagging infra-sre. @sanjay can you help with allocator telemetry?

sanjay: on it. grabbing allocator dump and nv-smi. can you record recent deploys?

amelia: no deploys in last 30m. traffic spike?  p50/p95 tokens normal. error-rate on route /v1/generate up from 0.2% -> 3.4% in last 10m.

ops-bot: customer-impact: 12 customers with failed requests in last 10m, top affected: ACME-inc (500 errors), internal-batch-job-7.

leo: posting nv-smi snapshot and kernel logs:```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 515.48.07    Driver Version: 515.48.07    CUDA Version: 11.7 |
| GPU 13: 80% memory  95% gpu | Processes: python(rlang) (pid 23456) 
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

sanjay: allocator metrics: total_reserved=24GB, headroom=2.1GB, free_slabs=1.9GB, largest_free_chunk=512MB, fragmentation_ratio=0.72. Looks like large contiguous allocations failing despite aggregate free memory.

amelia: that matches: OOM logs show "cudaMalloc failed: out of memory" while headroom>0. cur-kv-cache usage 18GB.

marta: can we evict prefix/KV cache for this node quickly? suggested command `curl -X POST http://orchestration.local/evict-kv?node=gpu-13`

amelia: doing evict now. also cordon node to stop new pods: `kubectl cordon gpu-13`

ops-bot: evict job started (job-id: evict-2026-03-15-01).

leo: evict finished, reclaimed 1.4GB contiguous, but fragmentation not fully solved. need larger contiguous block.

sanjay: observed pinned reserved blocks: some reserve pools holding 4x256MB blocks pinned due to long-lived tensors (attention cache). KV cache eviction should free up those but pinned slab allocator still splits.

amelia: temp mitigation: P1 route reroute -> move 30% traffic away from this node. Creating rollout: `routectl shift --from gpu-13 --pct 30 --to pool-b`

marta: updating status page: "Partial degradation: some requests may fail with 500; mitigation underway". Adding ACME support note.

sanjay: trying process restart of runtime on pod to release pinned GPU allocations gracefully: `kubectl exec -n prod pod/serving-42 -- supervisorctl restart runtime`

ops-bot: runtime restart executed; pods entering Terminating -> Running.

leo: post-restart: nv-smi shows memory freed, but within 30s some pods reallocated and OOM returned on one replica. logs: `alloc failed after reserve attempt for 600MB contiguous`

sanjay: this strongly points to fragmentation: allocator has headroom but cannot satisfy large contiguous allocation requested by model kv-cache or attention buffer. Possible triggers: growth step requests with seq_len spike or quantized kernels allocating big contiguous temp buffer.

amelia: suggestion: temporarily switch to smaller batch size on this node to avoid large per-request contiguous allocations. Patching config: `serve-config set --node gpu-13 --max-batch-size 4`

marta: can we escalate to Dedicated autoscaler to spin up a spare node? customers affected and traffic reroute only partially mitigates.

ops-bot: scaling request submitted to autoscaler (scale_request_id: scale-8492).

leo: telemetry shows a microburst 120s ago of several long-sequence requests (tokens>4096) to model-x-large causing a huge allocation. correlates with OOM start.

sanjay: short-term patches: 1) reduce max-batch-size 2) force kv-cache trim after each request (will increase latency) 3) restart a second replica to rebalance allocations. Which to prioritize?

amelia: prioritize 1 and 3. I’ll apply batch-size limit and restart additional replica to redistribute. @sanjay please prepare a small patch for kv-cache trim if needed. @marta please coordinate customer comms.

marta: calling out to ACME support with ETA 20m. posting public incident note soon.

ops-bot: replica restart job queued (job-id: restart-2026-03-15-02).

leo: after changes: error-rate dropped to 0.6%, OOM events fell to 0 in last 5m on gpu-13, but fragmentation still present. headroom reported 1.9GB but largest_free_chunk still ~600MB.

sanjay: follow-up remediation: we should add a fragmentation-aware reserve allocator or enable fallbacks to model variant with smaller peak memory. filing ticket: INF-5243.

amelia: handoff: I need to go offline for 15m to handle pager for another team. @sanjay you take lead. Please coordinate remaining cleanup and postmortem.

sanjay: taking over. plan: monitor 30m, validate no regressions, add temporary routing policy to avoid scheduling heavy seq_len requests onto gpu-13, and follow up with oncall runbook updates.

marta: confirmed customer comms sent. will update status page with timeline and next steps.

ops-bot: incident summary (automated): root-cause: fragmentation produced by large contiguous allocation requests (long sequence + KV cache) causing cudaMalloc failures despite aggregate headroom. mitigations: kv-cache eviction, node cordon, runtime restarts, traffic shift, batch-size cap, replica restart. impact: transient 3.4% error-rate spike, ~12 customers touched, ACME incident opened. follow-ups: INF-5243 (allocator fallback), add route policy, add telemetry for largest_free_chunk.

amelia: thanks team. please capture any additional logs into the incident ticket and assign owners. closing handoff to @sanjay. :white_check_mark:
